# ABC And You! Follow the ABCD Frame work in order ABCDE stands for [bold]A[/bold]ncestry, [bold]B[/bold]ackground, [bold]C[/bold]lass, [bold]D[/bold]ont Forget Scores, [bold]E[/bold]quipments.
Make sure you save your Character in Each step incase of any Bugs and report them to the discord! Curently there is no way to change your Character in Round, so make sure you are happy with your choices before moving on to the next step.
## (A)ncestry Ancestry is the first step in creating your character, it determines your species and what abilities you have access to. Each Ancestry has its own unique abilities and traits. - [bold]Ability Boosts[bold]: Gives +2 to specific ability scores and a free boost, plus +2 to a flaw (if applicable). - [bold]Ancestry Feat[bold]: Select 1 ancestry feat at level 1.
## (B)ackground Background is the second step in creating your character, it determines your character's past and what skills they have access to. Each Background has its own unique abilities and traits. - [bold]Origin story[bold]: Pick a background (e.g., Farmhand, Scholar, Street Urchin) that fits your concept. - [bold]Ability Boosts[bold]: Gives 2 ability boosts (one fixed/choice between two, one completely free). - [bold]Skill & Feat[bold]: Grants trained proficiency in a specific skill, a Lore skill, and a Skill Feat.
## (C)lass Class is the third step in creating your character, it determines your character's role in the party and what abilities they have access to. Each Class has its own unique abilities and traits. - [bold]Role & Abilities[bold]: Choose your class (e.g., Fighter, Wizard, Rogue) - [bold]Key Ability[bold]: Grants a +2 boost to your class’s primary ability score. - [bold]Features & Feats[bold]: Defines your Hit Points, initial saving throws, skill proficiencies, weapon/armor proficiencies, and 1st-level Class Feat.
## (D)on't Forget Scores Make sure to keep track of your character's ability scores throughout the character creation process. - [bold]Free Ability Boosts[bold]: Assign 4 free ability boosts to four different ability scores (Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma). - [bold]Score Cap[bold]: At Level 1, no ability score can exceed 18 (+4 modifier).
## (E)quipment & Details Make sure to keep track of your character's equipment and details throughout the character creation process. - [bold]Starting Wealth[bold]: Every Level 1 character begins with 15 gold pieces (gp) (150 silver pieces). - [bold]Details[bold]: Include any additional details about your character, such as appearance, personality, and background.
